result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane arterial road lacking basic pedestrian infrastructure such as sidewalks or marked crosswalks. While a traffic signal is present at an intersection, there are no visible pedestrian signals or refuge areas, creating a hostile environment for walking.

hazards.name: Lack of Sidewalks
hazards.description: There is no paved walkway for pedestrians, forcing them to walk in the grass or on the roadway shoulder.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and far side of the road

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane road lacks marked crosswalks or a median refuge, exposing pedestrians to high-speed traffic for a long duration.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the far side of the road may block sight lines between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Far side of the road near the buildings

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct continuous paved sidewalks on both sides of the roadway to provide a dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks and Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks and pedestrian signal heads at the signalized intersection to provide safe crossing opportunities.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to reduce crossing distance and allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The environment is highly hostile to pedestrians, featuring a wide multi-lane arterial road with no visible sidewalks or marked crossing infrastructure. The design prioritizes high-speed vehicle throughput, leaving pedestrians to navigate unpaved grass verges or the roadway itself.
